answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 5804 Country: United Kingdom Title: Can we eat ostrich meat and lobster? Question: Can we eat ostrich meat and lobster? Answer ID: 5804 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 376/376=M/1429) Ostrich is halal , one can eat its meat. There is difference of opinion about lobster ( jheenga ); some scholars call it fish while some not; therefore it is better to avoid eating it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
